about.title: Lindsay Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Lindsay is a small place, and when a family here loses someone suddenly, the loss is felt along Hermosa, down Tulare Road, and in the neighborhoods that surround them. Tulare County's public record shows Lindsay closed 2025 with 22 injury collisions and 33 people hurt, and no traffic deaths that year. That is a relief, not a promise about the years ahead. Fatal harm can still follow a collision on Route 65 or Mirage Avenue, a fall at a worksite, a medical mistake, or a defective product. Under California law, a wrongful death claim belongs first to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. It is a civil case, separate from anything a prosecutor may or may not file. Families generally have two years from the date of death to act, and less when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Lindsay families, for free, with an independent attorney who handles these claims on contingency.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to the spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can quickly tell your family where you fit.

items.title: The two-year clock, explained
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death, and a much shorter window if a city, county, or state agency may share fault. Early guidance protects that timeline.

items.title: Losses that are actually recoverable
items.desc: A claim can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Network attorneys take these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Lindsay reported no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death claims are rare here?
items.answer: Fewer fatal crashes is good news for the community, but wrongful death is not limited to the roadway. Deaths tied to farm and packing work, medical care, unsafe premises, or defective products can also give rise to a claim. If someone else's negligence played a part, it is worth a conversation with an attorney.

items.question: What if the crash happened on Route 65 and a government agency might be at fault?
items.answer: Route 65 is a state highway, so a claim involving road design or maintenance could involve a public entity. In that situation, California requires a formal claim to be filed much sooner than the usual two-year deadline. Speaking with an attorney early keeps that option open.

items.question: Do we have to wait for the criminal case to finish before filing?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs on its own track, whether or not the Tulare County District Attorney files charges. The two cases have different goals and different standards of proof. Your attorney can explain how they may affect each other.
